evidence.title: Enrich-Retrieve-Rank: Scaling Capability Discovery Beyond In-Context Routing

summary: Researchers introduce a novel AI framework called Enrich-Retrieve-Rank that scales capability discovery, moving past traditional in-context routing methods. The approach aims to enhance model performance by dynamically identifying and leveraging specialized skills.
title: New AI Framework 'Enrich-Retrieve-Rank' Advances Capability Discovery Beyond In-Context Routing
